title: Clicking from dev UI tests from container getting an error
body:
## Describe the bug
Clicking from dev UI tests from container throwing an  Internal server error
### Expected behavior
Should navigate to new test tab
### Actual behavior

## To Reproduce

https://github.com/hhovhann/quarkus-dev-ui-reproducer

Or attach an archive containing the reproducer to the issue.

Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Run application: ./mvnw -Pdrp -Dquarkus.profile=drp clean compile quarkus:dev
2. Goto http://localhost:8080/q/dev/
3. Click to Tests -> http://localhost:8080/q/dev/io.quarkus.quarkus-vertx-http/test
